protocol.eligibility: 18 or 19 detections, frame six 2..3 true and zero clutter, final exactly 2 true and zero clutter, frames 3..5 >=6, seventh >=1, maximum frame count <=4
protocol.decoys: largest nonnegative reference ID in each of frame six and final; y toward zero by frozen offset; labels become -1
protocol.order: within each stratum, bases by minimum maximum frame count then seed index, round-robin across bases at each sixth-then-final offset pair
protocol.selection: first quota numerically sound balanced variants on distinct bases per stratum; low/high alive >=.18, middle >=.05, two clutter categories >=.15 at both specified frames
protocol.stop: generator/ROI errors ineligible; numerical failure or CPU cap stops entire cohort; no replacement, threshold change or partial cohort inference; exhaustion gives no cohort
